domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved. thecompanycheck.com and zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403; tofler.in returned HTTP 404; DuckDuckGo search backend was unavailable (connection refused) for all queries, so no domestic-supply page could be located. Domestic supply is therefore not confirmed and not denied — null, not invented.
note: Export activity is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records, not by website claims: continuous lane of hot-beverage vending machines and spare parts Mundra -> Doha (Qatar) to Rightway Freight Services, HS 847601, BOLs from 2017-12-12 to 2022-06-09; and a current lane of tea/coffee premix and spares from Dadri ICD / Tuglakabad ICD / Delhi Air Cargo / Raxaul to UAE (Jebel Ali, Abu Dhabi), Nigeria (Lagos) and Nepal (Birgunj), latest record 2026-02-27. HS DISCREPANCY: declared HS 841869 (refrigerating equipment) does not match the actual recorded codes — 847601 (vending machines), 21012090 / 21011200 (tea and coffee premix), 39100090 (plastic washers). Per project rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection: company stays in the base, HS should be corrected to the factual codes, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Note also that the company is simultaneously an importer (Chinese suppliers Ningbo Metalwell Import & Export, Cixi Woohey Electrical Appliance, Guangdong Candor Intelligent Technology, Zhejiang Lanbao Electrical Appliance), i.e. it imports machine components and re-exports finished machines/premix — a manufacturer_trader profile. Industry claim 'IT и электроника' is inaccurate: actual business is food/beverage vending machines and instant premix. Revenue and export volume in value terms: null — ImportKey free view exposes shipment counts (2948) and BOL numbers but no FOB values; not invented. Legal entity existence not independently verified (registry pages blocked), but customs records under both name variants with matching Noida address indicate an active operating entity.
